title: Add DCORE to image
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [DCORE](https://bot.dtempest.online) to image
- A multi-purpose Discord-Telegram bot featuring image generation via Pollinations, along with useful commands for server owners, developers, and much more; it is currently active on 16 servers.

Fixes #14831

gist.headline: DCORE joins the garden
gist.blurb: DCORE has landed in the app garden: a Discord-and-Telegram helper that can grow Pollinations images alongside its useful server-owner and developer tools.
gist.summary: Added DCORE to the Pollinations app directory, highlighting a multi-purpose Discord-Telegram bot that provides Pollinations image generation and is already active across 16 servers.
gist.impact: People browsing Pollinations-powered projects can now discover DCORE as a ready-to-use bot for generating images and handling server and developer utilities.
gist.visual_concept: Depict DCORE as a friendly chunky pixel bot bridge between a Discord-style chat window and a Telegram-style paper-plane chat window, with a small generated landscape image emerging from both. Polli, wearing tiny moderator headphones, helps the bot tend a garden of code-plants to represent image generation and server tools.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of the cute Polli bee mascot with a yellow body, dark brown stripes, black antennae, oval black eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blushes, a small happy smile, and rounded translucent light-blue wings, wearing tiny moderator headphones while helping a friendly chunky bot tend code-plants between two retro chat terminals, one with a Discord-style speech bubble and one with a paper-plane message icon; a little generated pixel landscape blooms from the screens. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm cream garden shed, dark purple (#110518) outlines, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, soft scanlines, emotionally warm and nostalgic.
